info.syllabusName: Quản trị nguồn nhân lực Nhà hàng - Khách sạn (Human Resources Management in Hospitality Industry)
info.syllabusEnglish: Human Resources Management in Hospitality Industry
info.description:
In brief, the course strives to equip students with the necessary tools (i.e. conceptual frameworks and theories) to understand and appreciate the importance of HRM as part of the process of creating a successful organisation. On a higher level, this course aims to help students increase their knowledge of HRM as a fundamental component of the competitiveness, effectiveness, and sustainability of any organization.

Ultimately, the goal of the course is to show that HR management is significantly more than just accepting employment applications and keeping records; it is a strategic part of every organisation and it is probably the first place and the last place where organisational problems begin to form.

Chapter 1: Managing Human resources today

Chapter 2: Human resource strategy and analysis

Chapter 3: Job analysis and talent management

Chapter 4: Personnel planning and recruitin

Chapter 5: Selecting employees

Chapter 6: Training and Human resource development

Chapter 7: Performance management and appraisal

Chapter 8: Developing compensation plans

Chapter 9: Pay for performance and employee benefits

Chapter 10: Maintaining positive employee relations
